products.body_html:
This is based on our Pique Pocket Polo just a different fabric that is totally wonderful; smooth, stretchier and squishier - you'll love it (88% poly, 12% spandex).

Still totally dialed in just how we like it in a classic silhouette; sharp collar, deep four button placket, floating pocket and hidden SSC details all over.

For fit, we tried our best to nail this 'true to size' - certainly not slim fit, but not too boxy either and able to rock tucked or not.

  • Breathable and lightweight for warm weather
  • Classic Relaxed Fit, true to size
  • Four-button placket and structured collar
  • Designed for on-course and everyday wear
